description: This file defines a class MenuContextCardInjector that manages injecting a custom context menu card into an NSMenu in a macOS application. It handles cache refreshes, manages menu delegate methods, and incorporates SwiftUI views into AppKit menus.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for injecting a custom context card into macOS menu items, managing cache, and interfacing with SwiftUI views.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the menu injector into a given NSStatusItem, associating as its delegate and initializing cache warming.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles preparations when the menu opens, injecting the SwiftUI view, starting cache loading, and managing menu item placement.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Resets states and cancels ongoing cache load tasks when the menu closes.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Delegates menu update requests to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides the confinement rectangle for the menu, delegating to the original delegate if available.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the cached session rows unless a recent cache exists. Handles errors and updates cache metadata.

methods.name: cachedView
methods.description: Returns a SwiftUI view wrapped in AnyView, representing the current cache state.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows
methods.description: Loads and filters current session rows, sorting them by recency.

methods.name: findInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines where in the menu to insert the custom card, preferring before specific items.

methods.name: initialCardWidth
methods.description: Calculates the initial width of the card based on menu properties and previous measurements.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to measure the menu width for future use in layout calculations.
